issue.title: Bug: `test_lldp.py` testlets fail with `Missing in lldpcli: ['Ethernet-Rec0']`

failure.body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

Medium

### Description of the bug

Two new testlets were added in `test_lldp.py` in https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/pull/22420
`test_lldp_interfaces` and `test_lldp_interfaces_config_reload`.
But these two new tests don't consider if a platform has recycle ports to exclude them from the comparison with the LLDP output.
Hence the error:
```
>       pytest_assert(intf_status_filtered_for_lldpcli == lldpcli_interfaces_no_eth0,
                      "Interface mismatch between 'show interface status' (no PortChannels) and lldpcli{}. "
                      "Missing in lldpcli: {}, Extra in lldpcli: {}".format(
                          context, sorted(missing_in_lldpcli), sorted(extra_in_lldpcli)))
E       Failed: Interface mismatch between 'show interface status' (no PortChannels) and lldpcli. Missing in lldpcli: ['Ethernet-Rec0'], Extra in lldpcli: []
```

### Steps to Reproduce

Run `test_lldp_interfaces` or `test_lldp_interfaces_config_reload` on a SKU with recycle ports

### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

`test_lldp_interfaces` and `test_lldp_interfaces_config_reload` should exclude the recycle ports from the comparison with the lldp output

resolution.title: Exclude recirc ports in `test_lldp.py`
resolution.description:
### Description of PR
Two new tests added in https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/pull/22420 `test_lldp_interfaces` and `test_lldp_interfaces_config_reload` didn't exclude recirc ports from the `show interface status` output when comparing with lldp output causing failures

Details in - https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/issues/26864

Summary:
Fixes #26864

### Test result
- 202605: latest image

### Approach
#### What is the motivation for this PR?
Recirc ports won't have LLDP output so we shouldn't try to match them to the LLDP command output.

#### How did you do it?
Exclude any port with an alias that starts with `Recirc`

#### How did you verify/test it?
Ran the test on 202605 with a dut that has `Recirc` ports that was previously failing, now passing.
